name: Orlea Baskeheim
original_name: オルレア・バスクハイム
source:
Garrison commander of the border guards. Born into a family of soldiers, her older brother is an admiral and she has incredible skills in swordsmanship.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
